title: Low carbon optimal dispatch of integrated energy systems considering V2G and demand response under carbon trading mechanisms
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,6216-6234
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01008J, Paper
Peng Li, Zhuangye Ni, Xinwu Lei, Keke Ye, Zhonghe Han
This study develops an optimized scheduling model for integrated energy systems (IESs) under carbon trading mechanisms, incorporating vehicle to grid (V2G) and demand response (DR). It can reduce the cost and carbon emissions of IESs.
